## What this business is

TRIDS Gas & Plumbing is a local Gas Safe registered engineer serving Crewe and nearby Cheshire towns. It is not a national chain and does not operate fake branch offices in other towns.

Primary work: boiler repair, boiler servicing, boiler breakdowns, boiler installation, central heating repair, landlord gas safety certificates (CP12), gas cooker and hob installation, and general domestic plumbing.

## Coverage

Regular coverage: Crewe, Nantwich, Sandbach, Alsager, Middlewich, Winsford, Audlem, Holmes Chapel, Kidsgrove, Tarporley, Congleton and Northwich.

Further booked work is offered in nearby Cheshire and selected towns such as Whitchurch, Newcastle-under-Lyme, Knutsford, Macclesfield, Stoke-on-Trent, Chester, Warrington, Stockport and Manchester when travel from Crewe is practical.

## Safety

If you smell gas or suspect carbon monoxide, turn off the gas at the meter if it is safe, leave the property if needed, and call the National Gas Emergency Service on 0800 111 999. Do not use electrical switches.

Gas cookers, boilers and other gas appliances must be installed and serviced by a Gas Safe registered engineer.
